touch_definition: LONG: no-touch neu bar.low > limit; open-through neu low <= limit VA open <= limit (khop dam bao, khong draw); touch-only neu low <= limit VA open > limit (draw U<p_fill). SHORT doi xung: no-touch neu high < limit; open-through neu high >= limit VA open >= limit; touch-only neu high >= limit VA open < limit. Khop nhanh re engine _entry_fill.
rng_scheme: Tien xu ly deterministic per-signal: tin hieu thu j (0-indexed trong signals sort by bar_index), rng_j = numpy.random.default_rng(seed_base + j), seed_base=1729. Duyet expiry theo thu tu: open-through -> fill ngay (khong draw fill); touch-only -> draw U, fill neu U < p_fill, fail thi thu bar ke tiep trong expiry; no-touch -> tiep. Fill -> draw them 1 U_slip, slip neu U_slip < p_slip thi entry_price += direction*tick (LONG +0.1, SHORT -0.1 adverse). Moi branch reset RNG tu dau.
second_chance_expiry: entry_expiry_bars=12 tu dataset config (scan signal_index+1 .. signal_index+12, bo bar no-touch/failed touch-only, second chances trong expiry). holding cap = max(holding_days)*288 = 2016.
slippage: tick BTCUSDT 0.1 adverse, chi shift entry_price khi slip draw trung. Khong doi stop/TP frozen.
no_exec_stress_reason: probfill IS the stress (mo hinh khop xac suat thay the gia dinh khop-100%-khi-cham cua ohlc-v2). Them exec-stress 5bps penetration se double-count entry uncertainty va pha vo tinh cong bang seeded (control vs prob khong con khac nhau dung 1 yeu to). Giong v30: chi normal + fee_stress.
control_gate: Moi control (p_fill=1.0/p_slip=0.0) normal phai khop published control_reference (total_return + max_drawdown + trades, tolerance 1e-9) hoac STOP toan bo. 3/3 controls rerun de so sanh exact (12 cells = 6 control + 6 prob).
kill_criterion: PRE-SPEC: mot book MAT deployable shape neu probfill-normal giu fills>=30 NHUNG monthly_geometric_net < 0.5 x control-rerun-normal monthly (tuc monthly halving). Nguong half lay tu control rerun (du kien ~ published kill_half_monthly o tren). Fills<30 la mat gate rieng (khong phai kill-by-halving).
monthly_formula: ratio=final_equity/100; duration_years=(complete_evaluation_until - folds[0][0])/(365.2425*86400) theo parent_plan; monthly_geometric_net=ratio^(1/(12*duration_years))-1; headline NORMAL, fee_stress reference.
